package com.acme.shipping.label;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class TrackingNumberTest {

    @BeforeEach
    void reset() {
        TrackingNumber.resetSequenceForTests();
    }

    @Test
    void nextIsSequentialPerJvm() {
        LocalDate day = LocalDate.of(2026, 10, 28);
        assertThat(TrackingNumber.next("SX", day).value()).isEqualTo("SX-20261028-000001");
        assertThat(TrackingNumber.next("SX", day)).hasToString("SX-20261028-000002");
    }

    @Test
    void ofTrimsWhitespace() {
        assertThat(TrackingNumber.of("  AP-1  ").value()).isEqualTo("AP-1");
    }
}
